title: Approaches to Generative Artificial Intelligence, A Social Justice Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative visual analysis of images generated by text-to-image models (e.g., Midjourney) using generic, non-demographic prompts to reveal default racial stereotypes.
Qualitative visual analysis of images generated by text-to-image models using occupational prompts (e.g., doctor, nurse) to reveal default gender stereotypes.
Qualitative visual analysis of text-to-image generations to reveal stereotypical age associations linked to specific occupations.
Literature review of dataset provenance highlighting the overrepresentation of Western/US data and the marginalization of sources from the Global South.
Reviewing secondary research on the disproportionate false-positive rates of AI text detectors when evaluating writing by non-native English speakers.
